description: Bis-histidine ligated b-type heme parameters (non-covalently bound to protein)
references: Guberman-Pfeffer, M. J. Force field parameters for bis-histidine ligated b-type hemes developed using Metal Center Parameter Builder with B3LYP/mixed basis set. Parameterized from PDB 1CYO.
Li, P.; Merz, K. M. MCPB.py: A Python Based Metal Center Parameter Builder. J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2016, 56 (4), 599-604.

leaprc_groups.description: Required for PRN (the heme-derived propionate residue that the transformer carves out of HEM). constph defines the protonation-state types used by PRN. The combined 'Constant pH + Redox' picker option satisfies this because its leaprc list contains leaprc.constph.

Required for the heme residue itself (HBO/HBR). conste defines the redox-state-aware atom types used by the heme. The combined 'Constant pH + Redox' picker option satisfies this because its leaprc list contains leaprc.conste.

Guberman_HBR_RESP.description: Guberman-Pfeffer Fe(II) b-type heme parameters with RESP charges
Guberman_HBR_RESP.reference: Guberman-Pfeffer MCPB B3LYP/mixed basis set, RESP charge fitting

Guberman_HBR_CM5.description: Guberman-Pfeffer Fe(II) b-type heme parameters with CM5 charges
Guberman_HBR_CM5.reference: Guberman-Pfeffer MCPB B3LYP/mixed basis set, CM5 charge model

Guberman_HBO_RESP.description: Guberman-Pfeffer Fe(III) b-type heme parameters with RESP charges
Guberman_HBO_RESP.reference: Guberman-Pfeffer MCPB B3LYP/mixed basis set, RESP charge fitting

Guberman_HBO_CM5.description: Guberman-Pfeffer Fe(III) b-type heme parameters with CM5 charges
Guberman_HBO_CM5.reference: Guberman-Pfeffer MCPB B3LYP/mixed basis set, CM5 charge model

creates_bonds: Coordination bonds between Fe and histidine nitrogens
transformation_info.notes: Transforms standard b-type heme to bis-histidine ligated heme. Unlike c-type hemes, b-type hemes are not covalently attached to the protein via thioether bonds. The two axial histidine ligands are designated 'front' (FH*) and 'rear' (RH*) based on the parameterization model (PDB 1CYO). User assigns which protein histidine corresponds to each role.

history_note: 2026-05: all four sets were disabled because the reduced set (HBR) did not build (its lib used metal-shell types M2/Z1-Z6 while its frcmod and this metadata declared M1/Y1-Y6). 2026-07-04: fixed by relabeling the HBR frcmod (Guberman_HBR_RESP.frcmod and Guberman_HBR_CM5.frcmod) and this metadata's HBR atom_types from M1/Y1-Y6 to the M2/Z1-Z6 naming the HBR lib already used, keeping the oxidized HBO set on M1/Y1-Y6 so oxidized and reduced bis-His hemes remain type-distinct and can coexist in one topology. Bonded VALUES were not changed (they are genuine state-specific ferrous MCPB/Seminario fits). is_valid flipped to true. NOTE: the underlying QM/build-script/methodology source is not recoverable on this machine, so these values cannot be reproduced from on-disk artifacts; a fresh MCPB.py re-parameterization from PDB 1CYO (per the original publication) is planned to replace them. A tleap saveAmberParm build test under leaprc.conste + leaprc.constph should be run to confirm HBO and HBR build with zero missing parameters.
